stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: Claremont In Yo Stace! is now projected to beat TDsMaGee.
🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: The Mahomies just moved above the projected league median.
🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Moose Knucklers has been laid to rest (15.79 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 30.1 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: NE @ CHI (Thursday 8:15 PM), 13 league starters in action with 148.94 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (NE @ CHI): 13 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Ruffing the Passer vs Gibb it to Me Baby (38.24 pts projected).
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 32%, with In My Fantasy Era next at 25%.
🤝 Rivalry week: Gibb it to Me Baby leads Ruffing the Passer 5–1 all-time, and Gibb it to Me Baby has won the last 2.
🔥 TDsMaGee has won 3 straight. Claremont In Yo Stace! gets the next crack at them.
📈 TRENDING: Konata Mumpfield (WR, LAR) is one of the most-added players in fantasy over the past 24 hours. Nobody here has him.
🤔 What could have been: If Kyle Tucker and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Rice and Tuten for Stevenson and Williams back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 19% against Claremont In Yo Stace! — and won.
